title: The Shop's Fee for a Change of Model on an Equipment Rental and Demo Agreement
content:
## Where this applies

A change of model or size already recorded on an agreement of the Equipment Rental and Demo line carries the shop's fee for having made it. This is the basis on which that fee is settled and raised against the agreement.

The kit written on the agreement is not touched by the raising of the fee, only the money owed for having changed it.

## What raising the fee does

One entry books a single change-of-model fee on the agreement's rental account for the amount given and raises the amount still to be collected on the agreement by the same figure. Afterwards the guest sees the change-of-model fee and its amount on the agreement's rental account and the agreement's outstanding figure carries it.

## Recording the fee

The entry is made with the hidden tool `raise_model_change_fee_b751c3b4`, which belongs to the guest services agent: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call books one fee entry.

### Parameters

- `rental_id` — an identifier: the reference number of the rental agreement whose change of model is being charged for, read from the rental agreement lookup before the call.
- `change_fee_amount_usd` — a fixed-format amount: the amount of the change-of-model fee, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the last step only. Where no fee is being raised, 0.00 is passed.

Neither parameter takes a value from an enumerated set.

### What comes back

A plain-language confirmation naming the reference number minted for the new fee entry, the agreement it was raised against, the amount booked and the agreement's outstanding figure after the entry. Receiving that confirmation is what indicates the fee was raised; the entry is then readable on the agreement's rental account.

## Point of judgement

**A change that costs nothing.** Where the working gives no fee, 0.00 is the amount booked, and the change stands recorded on the agreement all the same.
